Aastha Spintex Shares See Volatile Trading After IPO Debut

Aastha Spintex shares experienced a volatile trading day following their initial public offering. The stock debuted at a discount to its IPO price, then later hit the 5% upper circuit. The company's IPO aimed to raise ₹170 crore, with funds earmarked for acquisition and working capital.
